title: Answer: the universe is a discrete deterministic finite-state machine

statements.text: What is fundamental is a discrete vacuum crystal over the field $K$, not a continuum of fields. The universe is a deterministic finite-state machine on 172 nodes, and its structure, interactions and periodic table follow from Diophantine geometry and topological invariants.

sources.quote: The universe is a deterministic Finite State Machine (FSM) on 172 nodes.
